MOOVALUR RAMAMIRTHAM AMMIYAR HIGHER EDUCATION ASSURANCE SCHEME (PUDHUMAI PENN SCHEME) 
 
1. 
Gist of the Scheme 
Under the Pudhumai Penn Scheme, female students who studied from Class 6 to Class 12 in Tamil Nadu Government schools are provided financial assistance of Rs. 1,000 per month to pursue higher education (Degree, Diploma, ITI, Professional courses). 
 
2. 
Objective 
To prevent school dropout among girl students, encourage higher education enrollment for female students from underprivileged backgrounds, and achieve gender equality in professional careers. 
 
3. 
Eligibility Criteria 
- Girl students who have continuously studied from Class 6th to 12th in Tamil Nadu Government Schools.
- Enrolled in undergraduate degree, diploma, ITI, or professional degree courses in recognized colleges/institutions.
- Applies to students in Government, Government-aided, and private colleges.
 
4. 
Benefits Provided 
Rs. 1,000/- per month transferred directly to the student's bank account until completion of the undergraduate degree or diploma course. 
 
5. 
Documents Required 
- Transfer Certificate / School Study Certificate (Classes 6 to 12 in Government School)
- Aadhaar Card of the student
- College Admission ID Card / Fee Receipt
- Bank Account details (Aadhaar linked)
 
6. 
How to Apply & Department 
- Online application via the official portal Penkal Kalvi (penkalvi.tn.gov.in) through the respective college Nodal Officers.
- Department: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department, Government of Tamil Nadu.
